hardware_access: read-only PWM check already performed; no sensor acquisition or PWM writes
detrend: own mean removed per axis per FFT segment
power: sum of XYZ power spectral densities, not spectrum of vector magnitude
frequency_axis: phase observed FIFO throughput; approximate sensor rate, not independently calibrated
bands_interpretation: fixed descriptive bins selected before spectral results; no fault labels or optimized thresholds
time_resolved_summary: all actual samples in each non-overlapping 5s host-time window, same Hann/PSD method; native frequency grids
